stages.name: Núcleo
stages.form: A SINGLE BARE SPHERE exactly like the reference labelled bare sphere. Absolutely NO rings, NO orbital arcs, NO grid, NO base or stand. Shading made of fine curved engraving hatching, bright bone center, dark engraved crescent at lower right.

request.description: Production-ready square 2D game asset for A Entidade Divina / Cult of the Sphere. Authentic Renaissance 16th-century occult copperplate engraving, Peter Apian cosmography, Durer woodcut. Bone-white and ash-silver engraved contours on a uniform PURE BLACK #000000 background, monochrome soot/charcoal/bone palette. Meticulous fine parallel curved hatching, cross-hatching, stippling, precise crisp linework. Centered symmetric cosmic globe floating in void. Globe center at canvas center; globe diameter 52% of canvas; outer structures fit within 86% canvas. Keep identical globe scale and position across evolution stages. No text, labels, numbers, ornamental frame, stars, people, wings, decorative flourishes, CGI, smooth gradients, neon, cartoons or painterly blur.
